tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lam rim sogs nas 'byung ba'i nyams len gyi

rim pa dang yan lag bdun pa byed tshul rnam pa gnyis bzhugs/ na mo gu ru mañju gho ṣā ya/ /spangs rtogs mthar phyin ston pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /skyes pa bla na med pa dam pa'i chos/ /rig grol gnyis kyi dpal ldan dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir ni dam pa'i legs bshad dang*/ /mthun pa'i chos 'ga' brjod par bya/ khams gsum sems can grangs mang yang*/ /bde 'gro'i lus rten rnyed par dkon/ khyad par dal 'byor tshang ba yi/ /mi lus yid bzhin nor ltar dkon/ /sangs rgyas bstan dang mjal ba dkon/ /dam chos thos bsam byed pa dkon/ /sgrub pas nyams su len pa dkon/ /'khor ba'i pha rol bgrod pa dkon/ /de bas sangs rgyas bsgrub pa dkon/ /de phyir tshe 'di'i bde ba tsam/ /don gnyer lto dang gos kyi ched/ /'jug pa'i skyes bu grangs mang yang*/ /gtan gyi bde ba byang chub phyir/ /'jug pa nyin mo'i skar ma bzhin/ /phyi ma byang chub bsgrub pa'i ched/ /'bad gang don gyi mchog yin la/ kha zas tsam phyir rgyugs pa ni/ /mi yi sha tshugs phyugs bzhin te/ /blun po'i phyugs kyang lto yi ched/ /'bad pas 'jug pa mthong min nam/ /de lta bas na thar 'dod kyi/ /skyes bu 'di ltar bsam bya ste/ /mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel bcas pa las/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i dge ba'i bshes/ /rgyun du bsten par byed pa nyid/ /'di phyi'i legs tshogs rtsa ba ru/ /gsungs phyir bsam sbyor rnam gnyis kyis/ /thog ma nyid nas bsten par rigs/ /de tshe bla ma lnga bcu bar/ /'dir mang smos pas ci zhig dgos/ / bla ma dgyes byed gang yin bya/ /mi mnyes byed kun spang ba ni/ /de dang de la 'bad de brtag /dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brang bar/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid gsung bar/ /shes nas dngos po thams cad kyis/ /bla ma yongs su mnyes par bya/ /nam yang slob dpon dag gi ni/ /kun tu sems dkrug mi bya ste/

/gal te rmongs pas byas gyur na/ /dmyal bar nges par 'tshed par 'gyur/ /mnar med la sogs 'jigs rung ba'i/ /dmyal ba bstan pa gang yin pa/ /slob dpon la ni smod pa rnams/ /der ni gnas par yang dag bshad/ /zhes dang dgra nag dka' 'grel las/ /tshigs bcad gcig tsam nyan pa la/ /gang gis bla mar mi 'dzin pa/ /khyi yi skye ba brgya blangs nas/ /rme sha can du skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i don ltar spangs blang bya/ /de nas shin tu rnyed dka' zhing*/ /rnyed na don che'i dal 'byor 'di/ /yid bzhin nor ltar dkon mthong nas/ /snying bo len pa'i tshul la 'bad/ /ngan song gsum dang yul mtha' 'khob/ /dbang bo ma tshang log lta can/ /rgyal ba'i bka' med tshe ring lha/ /mi khom 'di brgyad bral ba la/ /dal ba rnam pa brgyad ces bya/ /mi nyid dbus skyes dbang bo tshang*/ /las mtha' ma log gnas la dad/ /sangs rgyas byon dang dam chos ston/ /bstan pa gnas dang de rjes 'jug /gzhan phyir snying brtse 'byor ba bcu/ /dal brgyad 'byor bcu tshang ba yi/ /rten 'di rgyu 'bras ngo bo dang*/ /dpe yi sgo nas rnyed dka' bar/ /rgyal bas gsungs phyir lta ci smos/ /spyir ni bde 'gro'i rten tsam yang*/ /thob phyir dkar chos sngon 'gro ste/ /dge ba las ni phan bde'i rgyu/ / gzhan dag yod pa min phyir ro/ /'di 'dra'i dal ba rnyed gyur nas/ /dge la 'bad par ma byas na/ /de las bslus pa gzhan med cing*/ /de las rmongs pa gzhan med gsung*/ /phal mo che yi mi rnams ni/ /dam pa ma yin phyogs yongs 'dzin/ /des na so so skye bo rnams/ /phal cher nges par ngan 'gro ru/ /'gro bar gsungs phyir ci nus kyis/ /sdig pa spong la dge ba sgrubs/ /de la thog mar mi rtag tshul/ /bsam pa shin tu gal che'i phyir/ /de yang nges par 'chi ba ste/ / nam 'chi cha ni med pa dang*/ /shi ba'i tshe na chos ma gtogs/ /gzhan gyis phan par mi nus bsam/ /las nyon dbang gis blangs pa yi/

/lus ni ji 'dra yin phyin chad/ /nges par 'chi ba chos nyid de/ /yul dang sa phyogs gang gnas kyang*/ /'chi bas mi tshugs yod ma yin/ /dper na byis pas nam mkha' la/ /'phangs pa'i rdo ni ltung ba bzhin/ /yang na nyi rgas grib ma bzhin/ /'chi bdag bdud ni tshur tshur 'ong*/ /de yang dus la bab pa na/ /sman sogs kun gyis bzlog mi nus/ /de phyir nges par 'chi ba nyid/ /mi rtag tshoms las 'di skad gsung*/ /de la mi 'di gzhon zhes pa'i/ /gson pa'i gdengs drod ci zhig yod/ kha cig mngal du 'chi bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin kha cig btsas pa'i sar/ / de bzhin kha cig gog tsam na/ /de bzhin kha cig yongs rgyugs na/ /la la rgan dang la la gzhon/ /la la dar la bab pa'i mi/ /rim gyis 'chi bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ /nam 'chi la ni cha ma mchis/ /ma 'ongs dus tshe gling bzhi ni/ /ri rab bcas pa'i stong gsum gyi/ /'jig rten 'di yang chu yis gshig /me yis 'tshig gam rlung gis gtor/ /rdul phran tsam yang med 'gyur na/ /'dus byas gzhan dag lta ci smos/ /'dus pa kun gyi mthar 'bral zhing*/ /bsags pa kun gyi mtha' yang 'dzad/ /mthon po'i mtha' ni rgud 'gyur la/ /skyes pa kun gyi mtha' mar 'chi/ /mdor na rgyu rkyen las byung ba'i/ /'dus byas kun kyang mi rtag go /shi nas rgyun chad 'gyur min te/ /rang rang ji ltar bsags pa yi/ / dkar nag las kyis 'phangs pa ltar/ /bde 'gro ngan 'gro gang rung du/ /nges par skye ba len phyir ro/ /de yang dge ba'i las kyis ni/ /mtho ris skye zhing bder 'gyur la/ /mi dge'i las kyis ngan 'gro ru/ /skye 'gyur sdug bsngal chos nyid do/ /dper na gro yi sa bon las/ /'bras bu gro nyid skye 'gyur gyi/ /nas la sogs par mi 'gyur bzhin/ /gzhan yang 'jig rten khams 'di na/ /lo tog rnams dang rtsi shing sogs/ /khyad par ji snyed yod pa kun/ /gegs byed med na rang rang gi /'bras bu so sor ma nor bar/

/'byin pa kun gyis mthong ba bzhin/ /gal te mi dge'i las kyis ni/ /ngan song gnas su skyes gyur na/ /mi bzad sdug bsngal 'di ltar yod/ /dmyal ba tsha grang sdug bsngal che/ /yi dwags bkres shing skom pas gzir/ /dud 'gro gcig la gcig za dang*/ /rmongs pa'i sdug bsngal du mas mnar/ /dmyal ba'i gnas ni 'dzam gling 'di'i/ /'og tu dpag tshad sum khri dang*/ /nyis stong gis ni chod pa na/ /yang sos dmyal ba yod pa ste/ /de nas bzhi stong bzhi stong gi /dpag tshad kyis ni chod pa na/ /tsha dmyal gzhan dag bdun po yod/ /dmyal ba dang po yang sos kyi/ /sdug bsngal khyad par 'di lta ste/ /sems can de dag tshogs pa'i tshe/ /las kyi dbang gis phan tshun kun/ /gcig la yang ni gcig gis kyang*/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs snun par byed/ /de yi rkyen gyis shi ba na/ /nam mkha' las ni khyed cag kun/ /sos par gyur cig ces pa'i sgra/ /byung tshe slar yang langs nas ni/ /sngar bzhin phan tshun mtshon rdeg pas/ khor yug sdug bsngal dpag med myong*/ /gnyis pa dmyal ba thig nag ni/ /dmyal ba'i srung mas sems can de/ /bzung nas lus la thig btab ste/ /sog le la sogs mtshon rnon pos/ /btab pa ji bzhin gsheg par byed/ /gsum pa dmyal ba bsdus 'joms ni/ /sems can de rnams lhan cig tu/ /'dus tshe dmyal ba'i srung ma yis/ /lcags kyi ri yi bar dag tu/ /btsir nas rdul bzhin rlog byed cing*/ /dbang bo'i sgo la sogs pa nas/ /khrag rgyun dmar chal 'bab par 'gyur/ /bzhi pa dmyal ba ngu 'bod ni/ /sems can de dag lcags khang nang*/ /bcug ste me 'bar 'tshig par byed/ /lnga pa ngu 'bod chen po ni/ /lcags khang nyis rim nang bcug nas/ /mes sreg ngu 'bod chen po byed/ /drug pa tsha ba'i dmyal ba ni/ /dmyal ba'i srung mas sems can de/ / bzung nas lcags zangs 'bar ba'i nang*/ /nya ni gson por sreg bzhin byed/ /lcags kyi gsal shing 'bar ba yis/

/'phongs nas phug ste spyi bor 'byin/ /de tshe kha mig rna ba dang*/ /sna bug ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /me lce 'bar bas sreg pas 'tshig /lcags kyi sa gzhi 'bar ba la/ /gan rkyal bzhag nas me 'bar ba'i/ /lcags kyi tho bas rdung zhing dmyal/ /bdun pa rab tu tsha ba ni/ /lcags kyi gsal shing rtse gsum pas/ /'phongs su bcug ste rtse mo gsum/ /spyi bo phrag pa g.yas g.yon 'byin/ /de tshe kha sogs dbang bo'i sgor/ /me lce kun nas 'bar bas sreg /lcags glegs tsha zhing 'bar ba yis/ /lus dkris lcags zangs 'bar ba'i nang*/ /sran ma bzhin du btsos pa na/ /pags pa sha khrag kun zhig ste/ /keng rus 'ba' zhig lus pa'i tshe/ /phyung ste lcags kyi sa gzhir 'grem/ /slar yang pags pa skyes pa na/ /sngar bzhin nang bcug khor yug tu/ /sdug bsngal dpag med nyams su myong*/ /brgyad pa mnar med dmyal ba ni/ /phyogs bzhi'i lcags kyi sa gzhi ni/ /shin tu 'bar las me yi shugs/ /'ongs nas sems can de dag gi /pags pa sha rus rgyu ma rnams/ /rim gyis tshig nas rkang la thug /de tshe mar me'i sdong bu bzhin/ /lus kun me lce 'bar bas khyab/ /lcags kyi zhib ma'i nang du ni/ /me mdog 'bar bar 'khrab tu 'jug /lcags kyi ri la 'bab 'dzeg byed/ kha nas lce phyung phur bu brgyas/ /rgyang zhing 'then nas rmo bar byed/ /lcags kyi thu lum dmar 'bar ba/ kha yi nang du 'jug pa dang*/ /tsha ba'i zangs bskol sdud par byed/ /de tshe kha dang mgrin pa dang*/ /rgyu ma rnams 'tshig smad nas 'byung*/ /de sogs sdug bsngal dpag tu med/ /de rnams kyi ni tshe yi tshad/ /spyir na mi dge'i las gang yin/ /ma zad bar du myong ba ste/ /bye brag phye na 'di ltar ro/ /mi lo lnga bcu bsdoms pa la/ /rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i zhag gcig ste/ /de sum cu la zla ba dang*/ /de bcu gnyis la lor byas pa'i/ /lo ni lnga brgya rgyal chen bzhi'i/ /lha yi tshe tshad yin pa ste/

/de rnams gcig tu bsdoms byas pa/ /yang sos dmyal ba'i nyin zhag gcig /de sum cu la zla ba dang*/ /bcu gnyis lor byas lnga brgya ni/ /yang sos dmyal ba'i tshe tshad de/ /mi yi lo ltar brtsis pa'i tshe/ /dung phyur stong las ches lhag pa'i/ /mi lo khrag khrig chen po gcig /khrag khrig drug dang ther 'bum ni/ /chen po gnyis su 'gyur ba yin/ /'on kyang tsha dmyal gzhan kun las/ /'di nyid tshe lo thung ba ste/ /de yang mi lo brgya dang ni/ /nyis brgya bzhi brgya brgyad brgya dang*/ /stong dang drug brgya rnams rim bzhin/ /sum cu rtsa gsum 'thab bral dang*/ /dga' ldan 'phrul dga' gzhan 'phrul dbang*/ /so so'i zhag re yin pa ste/ /rim bzhin rang gi lo stong dang*/ /nyis stong bzhi stong brgyad stong dang*/ /khri dang drug stong thub 'gyur zhing*/ /sum cu rtsa gsum lha yi lo/ /stong phrag gcig tu bsdoms byas pa/ /thig nag dmyal ba'i zhag gcig yin/ /rang lo stong phrag gcig thub ste/ /de la mi lo rab bkram gcig /khrag khrig chen po rnam gnyis dang*/ /khrag khrig dgu dang ther 'bum ni/ /chen po drug tu 'gyur ba yin/ /'thab bral lha yi lo nyis stong*/ /gcig bsdoms bsdus 'joms nyin zhag gcig /rang lo nyis stong thub po der/ /mi lo rab bkram chen po gcig /khrag khrig chen po gsum dang ni/ /khrag khrig drug dang ther chen brgyad/ /dga' ldan lha yi lo bzhi stong*/ /gcig bsdoms ngu 'bod nyin zhag gcig /rang lo bzhi stong thub po der/ /mi lo rab bkram chen po brgyad/ /rab bkram gnyis dang khrag chen dgu/ /khrag khrig bzhi dang ther chen bzhi/ /'phrul dga'i lha yi lo brgyad stong*/ /gcig bsdus ngu 'bod chen po yi/ /zhag gcig rang lo brgyad stong la/ /mi lo gtams drug bkram chen drug /rab bkram gsum dang khrag chen lnga/ /khrag khrig lnga dang ther chen gnyis/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed lha yi lo/

khri dang drug stong kun bsdoms pa/ /tsha ba yi ni zhag gcig ste/ /rang lo khri dang drug stong ste/ /me lo'i grangs ni gtams chen lnga/ / gtams gsum rab bkram brgyad dang ni/ /khrag khrig che bzhi khrag khrig gcig /ther 'bum chen po drug tu 'gyur/ /mdor na de dag kun gyi tshe/ /snga ma snga ma rnams las ni/ /phyi ma phyi ma brgyad 'gyur ring*/ /rab tu tsha ba bar bskal phyed/ /mnar med dmyal ba'i tshe tshad ni/ /bar gyi bskal pa gcig thub bo/ / dmyal ba brgyad po re re yi/ /phyogs bzhir me ma mur gyi 'obs/ /ro myags 'dam dang spu gri'i lam/ /chu bo rab med rnam pa bzhi/ /spu gri'i lam dang nye ba na/ /sha ma li yi nags tshal yod/ /de dag re re na yang ni/ /sdug bsngal khyad par dpag med myong*/ /tsha dmyal brgyad kyi thad so yi/ /dpag tshad khri yi pha rol na/ /gangs ri'i khor yug rlung 'tshub pa'i/ /grang ba'i dmyal ba brgyad yod la/ /dang po grang dmyal chu bur can/ /grang bas lus la chu bur byung*/ /gnyis pa chu bur rdol ba ni/ /shin tu grang nas chu bur rdol/ /gsum pa grang nas so tham tham/ /bzhi ba grang nas kyi hud zer/ /lnga bas a chu chu zhes zer/ /drug pa shin tu grang ba'i stobs/ /lus ni ut+pa la ltar gas/ /bdun pa de las ches grang nas/ /lus ni pad+ma lta bur gas/ /brgyad pa ches grang lus kyi mdog / rab dmar tshal pa brgyar gas te/ /pad+ma chen po lta bur gyur/ /dang po'i tshe tshad mi lo'i grangs/ khrag khrig brgyad dang ther chen gcig /lhag ma bdun gyi tshe tshad ni/ /nyi shu nyi shus 'phar zhing ring*/ /dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal che khyad ni/ /dper na mdung thung sum brgya yis/ /su la dus gcig drag btab ste/ /sdug bsngal byung ba de yis ni/ /dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal chung ngur yang*/ /'gran par nus pa min no gsung*/ /yi dwags gnas su skyes pa yang*/ /zas skom mi rnyed bkres shing skom/ /sha pags sdong dum mes 'tshig bzhin/

/chu klung mthong ste brgyugs pa na/ /de tshe ral gri mdung thogs pa'i/ /skyes bus 'thung du mi ster zhing*/ /chu klung rnag dang khrag tu 'gyur/ /yi dwags rnam pa sna tshogs las/ kha cig gsus pa yul ljongs bzhin/ kha ni khab kyi mig tsam zhig /zas skom mi rnyed rnyed gyur kyang*/ khar mi shongs shing shongs na yang*/ /gsus pa khengs par mi 'gyur ro/ / yang na lto ba rgyu sogs 'tshig /la la mi gtsang ljan ljin za/ kha cig rang sha bcad nas za/ /la la me bdag zos nas 'tshig /de dag rnams kyi tshe yi tshad/ /mi yi zla ba gcig la ni/ /yi dwags kyi ni zhag gcig ste/ /de ltar brtsis pas rang gi lo/ /lnga brgya thub par 'gyur ba yin/ /de dag rnams su skye ba'i rgyu/ /mi dge spyi dang khyad par du/ /sbyin pa la sogs dge phyogs su/ /ser sna byas las 'gyur ba yin/ /dud 'gror skyes tshe gcig gis gcig/ gsod dang za ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ /rmongs shing legs nyes 'byed mi shes/ / lha dang mi yi dbang 'gyur ba/ khur bskur bcings dang rdeg sogs kyis/ /sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs myong*/ /tshe tshad ring ba bskal ba dang*/ /thung ba nyin zhag gcig kyang srid/ /de phyir ngan song gsum dag na/ /dus min 'chi ba yod pa ste/ /las stobs che chung khyad par gyis/ /la la skyes tsam nyid nas thar/ / 'ga' zhig bar skabs nas kyang thar/ /gzhan dag tshe ni rdzogs kyi bar/ /gal te mi dge'i las de nyid/ /zad na bde 'gror skye 'gyur yang*/ /ma zad dmyal ba nas 'phos te/ /yi dwags gnas su skye ba'am/ /yang na dud 'gror skye 'gyur la/ /yi dwags nas ni dmyal ba dang*/ /dud 'gror skye bar 'gyur ba'am/ /dud 'gro nas ni dmyal ba dang*/ /yi dwags gnas su skye ba'ang yod/ /'gro drug gnas nas ngan 'gro ru/ /skye ba sa yi rdul 'dra ste/ /de nas bde 'gror skye ba ni/ /thub pa'i phyag sen rtse mo yis/ /bzhes pa'i rdul bzhin shin tu nyung*/

/mi dge kho nas ngan song dang*/ /dge ba kho nas bde 'gro ru/ /skye bar nges mod dge sdig gnyis/ /'dres mar spyad pas 'bras bu yang*/ /bde sdug 'dres mar myong bar 'gyur/ /dper na kha cig tshe stod bde/ /tshe smad sdug bsngal myong ba dang*/ /la la tshe stod sdug pa las/ /tshe smad bde bar 'gyur ba bzhin/ /la la sngon las gtso che bar/ /gnas skabs rkyen gyis bsgyur ba'ang srid/ /tshe 'dir dge la mi spyod pa'i/ /skyes bu kha cig longs spyod sogs/ /bde bar ldan par snang de ni/ /sngon las rgyu byas 'phral rkyen la/ /brten nas byung med las 'bras kyi/ khyad par mi shes skyes bu 'gas/ /rang stobs kho nas byas snyam yang*/ /de ltar yin na khyod nyid kyis/ /gro nas sran ma la sogs pa'i/ /sa bon btab pa gang yin las/ /'bras bu so sor ma nor bar/ /bskyed cing de yi kha dog dang*/ /ring thung la sogs dbyibs rnams kyi/ khyad par ji snyed yod gyur gang*/ /de dag khyod kyis byas sam ci/ /byas na khyod ni ngo mtshar che/ /yang na khyod rang ji ltar 'jog /khyod kyi mgo dang rkang lag dang*/ /mig rna la sogs khyod yin nam/ /yang na rnam par shes pa khyod/ /de las gzhan pa gang zhig yin/ /yin na khyod kyis brjod par gyis/ /mgo la sogs pa khyod yin na/ / sngon med ma mthong ya mtshan che/ /de lta na ni khyod nyid gzugs/ /gzugs yin gyur pa'i gang zag su/ /mig sogs yin na'ang de bzhin 'gyur/ /rnam par shes pa khyod yin na/ /rnam shes gzugs can khyod mthong ngam/ /gal te de dag las gzhan na/ /khyod kyi lus dang yan lag las/ /don gzhan yan gar yod na de/ /khyod kyis de lta ston par rigs/ /gal te rang nyid tshul bzhin du/ /'jog mi shes so zer na ni/ /rang nyid 'jog kyang mi shes pa/ /khyod kyis las 'bras phra ba yi/ /'jog tshul ji ltar shes par nus/ /de phyir 'jig rten mthong ba yi/ /snang tshul 'di tsam rjes 'brang nas/

/shin tu phra ba'i las 'bras la/ / log par lta bar ma byed cig /ci phyir zhe na sangs rgyas dang*/ /rgyal sras rigs pa'i dbang phyug gis/ /las 'bras nges pa bskyed pa'i phyir/ /rigs pa'i rnam grangs bye ba brgyas/ /legs par gtan la phab pa'i tshul/ /phra zhing rtogs par dka' ba nyid/ /mkhas pa yis kyang nges dka' na/ /rmongs pa khyod ltas ji ltar shes/ /de phyir las dang 'bras bu'i tshul/ /bsam gyis mi khyab nyid do zhes/ /gus par byas na ngan 'gro las/ /grol 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /ci phyir zhe na sangs rgyas kyis/ /'jig rten pa yi yang dag lta/ /mi gang su la yod gyur pa/ /de ni bskal pa stong rnams su/ /ngan 'gror 'gro bar mi 'gyur gsung*/ /gzhan du log ltas ngan 'gror 'phen/ /gzhan yang ngan 'gro las thar te/ /bde 'gror skye bar 'dod gyur na/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum po la/ /tshig tsam brjod pa ma yin par/ /'jigs pa dag las skyob pa'i ched/ /re bltos snying nas 'cha' ba yi/ /skyabs su 'gro ba'i skyabs 'gro dgos/ /de yang dkar nag las 'bras la/ /blang dor byed par rag las so/ /de la thog mar dad pa dgos/ /dad pa yis ni ngan song spong*/ /dad pas mtho ris 'khrid par byed/ /dad pa med pa'i mi dag la/ /dkar po'i chos rnams mi skye ste/ /sa bon me yis tshig pa las/ /myu gu sngon po ji bzhin no/ /su zhig dkon mchog gsum po la/ /skyabs su ma song gang yin pa/ /de ni nang ba ma yin te/ /nang pa'i khyad par dkon mchog la/ /skyabs su song nas 'jog phyir ro/ /de yang skyabs gnas sangs rgyas nyid/ /don gnyis mtha' ru phyin pa ste/ /dbye na chos dang gzugs sku gnyis/ /chos la grol byed lam bden dang*/ /grol ba 'gog pa'i bden pa gnyis/ /dge 'dun skye 'phags rnam gnyis las/ /gtso bo 'phags pa'i gang zag ste/ /'dir ni rgyas par brjod mi byed/ /mi shes rmongs pa kha cig ni/ /phyogs bcu'i nam mkha'i khyon gyi

mtha'/ /ji snyed sangs rgyas zhing rnams na/ /sus kyang grangs kyis mi lang ba'i/ /grangs med sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /mchis shing de yang la la ni/ /shin tu dag pa'i zhing rnams na/ /dgyes dgur spyod cing bzhugs pa dang*/ kha cig gdul bya'i dbang gis ni/ /ci ltar rigs pa'i zhing dag na/ /bzhugs pa'i khyad par lung dang ni/ /rigs pa yis ni mi shes par/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa'i skyes chen nam/ /rgyal sras 'gro ba'i don byed pa'i/ /dam pa'i skyes bu kun mkhyen du/ /btags pa 'ga' zhig sangs rgyas su/ /bzung nas sangs rgyas kun kyang ni/ /'di 'dra'i ngang tshul yin nam sems/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang tha mal pa'i/ /skyes bu bzhin du 'chi snyam ste/ /las 'bras log par lta byed pa'i/ /lta ngan rgyud la goms par byed/ /de ltar lta ba'i skyes bu des/ /nam mkha' khams kyi rgya chod dam/ /shes bya'i mtha' yang 'dzin 'dod phyir/ /'di las rmongs pa gzhan su zhig /sems can khams dang sangs rgyas kyi/ /mtha' tshad kun mkhyen ye shes kyis/ /ma rnyed gang de 'di 'dra'i mis/ /shes par 'dod phyir e ma mtshar/ /de bas gdul bya'i bsam pa dang*/ /bstun pa'i tshul las gzhan du ni/ /sangs rgyas rang nyid kyis brnyes pa'i/ /sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba'i gnas/ /bsam gyis mi khyab ji snyed tshul/ /rgyal sras nyan rang 'phags pa dang*/ /lha dang mi sogs 'jig rten gyis/ /ji bzhin shes par mi nus na/ /gzhan pa su zhig gis ni shes/ /des na sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni/ /gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab ces/ /yongs su shes pa gang yin des/ / sangs rgyas chos rnams shes nus shing*/ /kun mkhyen nyid kyang 'thob bshad na/ /bde 'gror skye ba lta ci smos/ /sangs rgyas la ni skyabs song bas/ /'jig rten lha la skyabs mi 'gro/ /chos la skyabs su song bas ni/ /sems can gzhan la gnod 'tshe spong*/ /dge 'dun la ni skyabs song tshe/ /grogs ngan mu stegs can mi 'grogs/

/dus kun phyag mchod sdig bshags sogs/ /yan lag bdun pa'i tshul la 'bad/ /bde 'gror skye ba'i rgyu mang yang*/ /gtso bo dge ba bcu nyid de/ /bzlog na mi dge rnam pa bcu/ /de yang srog gcod ma byin len/ /log g.yem rdzun du smra ba dang*/ /phra ma tshig rtsub ngag kyal dang*/ /brnab sems gnod sems log lta ste/ /lus kyi gsum dang ngag gi bzhi/ /yid kyi gsum ste bcu rnams so/ /dge ba che 'bring chung gsum gyis/ /rim bzhin gong ma'i lha dag dang*/ /'dod lha mi ru skye 'gyur la/ /mi dge che 'bring chung gsum rim/ /dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gror skye/ /las kyi 'bras bu tshe 'di 'am/ /phyi ma nyid du myong ba dang/ /phyi ma'i phyi mar myong ba gsum/ /gzhan yang myong bar nges pa dang*/ /myong bar ma nges las rnam gnyis/ /ma byas ma bsags byas shing bsags/ /bsags la ma byas las rnam gsum/ /'phen byed dge bas 'phangs pa la/ /rdzogs byed dge bas rdzogs pa dang*/ /mi dges rdzogs pa gnyis yod de/ /dper na bde 'gror skyes pa gang*/ /dus kun du ni bde ba dang*/ /bder 'gror skyes kyang dbul bo bzhin/ /'phen byed mi dges 'phangs pa la/ /mi dge'i las ky-is rdzogs pa dang*/ /dge bas rdzogs pa rnam gnyis te/ /dper na ngan 'gror skyes pa gang*/ /dus rnams kun tu sdug bsngal dang*/ /dud 'gror skyes kyang bde ba bzhin/ /de yang rin chen phreng ba las/ /mi dge ba las sdug bsngal kun/ /de bzhin ngan 'gro thams cad do/ /dge las bde 'gro thams cad dang*/ /skye ba kun tu bde ba dag /zhes pa'i tshul gyis las gnyis las/ /'bras bu so sor mi 'khrul par/ /'byung gi gzhan du 'gyur ba med/ /ci 'dra ba yi las byas pa/ /'bras bu de 'dra 'thob 'gyur bar/ / gsungs phyir las 'bras phra ba kun/ /sangs rgyas kyis mkhyen gzhan gyis min/ /lus can kun gyi las rnams ni/ /bskal ba brgyar yang chud mi za/

/ tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu smin pa nyid 'gyur bar/ /gsungs phyir mi dge'i las kyis ni/ /bshags pa la sogs rkyen med na/ /'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byin 'gyur bas/ /de phyir stobs bzhi bsten par bya/ /mi dge'i las la 'gyod pa'i sems/ /mang du byas te bshags pa ni/ /dang po rnam par sun 'byin stobs/ /mdo sde zab mo gzungs sngags 'don/ /rten bzhengs mchod pa 'bul ba dang*/ /stong pa nyid la mos pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi mtshan/ /brjod sogs gnyen po kun spyod stobs/ /phyin chad sdig pa mi byed par/ /dam bca' brtan po byed pa ni/ /nyes pa las ni slar log stobs/ /skyabs 'gro byang chub sems sgom sogs/ /rten gyi stobs su rgyal bas bshad/ /'di bzhi rgyun du bsten byed na/ /las kyi sgrib pa kun byang ste/ /ngan 'gro las grol the tshom med/ /las dang nyon mongs rnam gnyis las/ /dang po'i las can gang zag gis/ /las sgrib sbyong pa gnad che bar/ /blo bzang rgyal pa gnyis pas bshad/ /thar ba 'dod pas thog mar 'di ltar bsam/ /bde 'gro na yang bde sdug 'dres ma dang*/ /tshe la'ang ring thung sna tshogs 'di lta ste/ /sgra mi snyan pa tshe stong thub nges shing*/ /nub tu lnga brgya shar du phyed sum brgya/ /'dzam gling 'di na da lta brgyad cu man/ /sngon tshe dpag med ma 'ongs bcu bar 'gyur/ /rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i lha yi tshe tshad ni/ /mi lo sa ya dgu'o lhag ma ni/ /bzhi 'gyur gyis ring sum cu rtsa gsum ni/ /mi lo bye ba gsum dang sa ya drug /'thab bral dung gcig bye bzhi sa ya bzhi/ /dga' ldan dung lnga bye bdun sa ya drug /'phrul dga' ther 'bum gnyis dang dung 'phyur gsum/ /sa ya bzhir 'gyur gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa/ /mi lo ther 'bum dgu dang dung 'phyur gnyis/ /bye ba gcig dang sa ya drug thub 'gyur/ /gzugs khams tshangs ris tshe ni bar bskal phyed/

/'dun na 'don dang tshangs chen phyed phyed ring*/ /'od chung nas bzung bskal ba chen po'o/ /gzugs med nam mkha' mtha' yas la sogs bzhi/ /rim bzhin tshe tshad bskal chen nyi khri dang*/ /bzhi khri drug khri brgyad khri thub par bshad/ /'on kyang de dag dus min 'chi ba yod/ kha dog longs spyod sogs kyi khyad par ni/ /sgra mi snyan dang gzugs khams lha rnams dkar/ /gling gzhan gsum dang 'dod lha rigs drug na/ kha dog sna tshogs nyid du gyur ba yod/ kha zas sgra mi snyan na ma 'bad par/ /ma rmos lo tog dpag bsam shing sogs las/ /byung ba'i zas dang gos la longs spyod cing*/ /gling gzhan gsum na 'bad pas bsgrubs te spyod/ /'dod lha drug la rang gis bsgrubs pa dang*/ /ma bsgrubs dpag bsam shing las byung ba yi/ /zas dang gos kyi khyad par rnams la spyod/ /bsgrub pa'ang sprul pa'i zas gos lta bu ste/ /zhing gi so nom byas las byung ba min/ /nor dang 'bru ni lha gnas yod ma yin/ /gzugs khams gtso bor ting 'dzin zas la spyod/ /tsha grang sdug bsngal lha dang byang na med/ /gzugs khams yan na dbyar sogs dus bzhi dang*/ /nyin mtshan pha ma bran gyi khyad par med/ /'dod khams lha ru rdzus te skye ba ni/ /lha mo'i pang dang phrag par thol gyis 'byung*/ /gzugs khams lha rnams gos dang bcas par skye/ /gzugs med khams na khyad par de dag med/ /sgra mi snyan dang lha yi gnas dag na/ /zag bcas bde ba'i khyad par du ma myong*/ /de dag dge ba'i las stobs che chung gis/ /longs spyod che chung khyad par dag kyang 'byung*/ /'on te sdug bsngal dag kyang 'di ltar yod/ /rgyal chen rigs bzhi sum cu rtsa gsum rnams/ /lha ma yin dang 'thab pas lus kyi gnad/ /bcad cing btub pa'i sdug bsngal du ma dang*/ /'thab bral sogs na de ltar yod min kyang*/ /'chi ltas mthong bas sdug bsngal dpag tu med/ / gzugs dang gzugs med khams kyi lha rnams la/

/'jig rten grags pa'i sdug bsngal rigs med cing*/ /ting 'dzin bde la yun ring gnas mod kyang*/ /'du byed sdug bsngal nyid kyis bcings pa'i phyir/ /nam mkhar 'phur ba'i bya ni ji bzhin du/ /slar yang 'og ma'i gnas su ltung bar 'gyur/ /lha min 'thab cing rtsod pa'i sdug bsngal dang*/ /mi la skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal te/ /de ltar 'gro ba rigs drug thams cad kyang*/ /'du byed sdug bsngal 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ /sdug bsngal gyi ni sdug bsngal gsum po las/ /gang yang rung bas gzir ba'i tshul bsam bya/ /de yang nye bar len pa'i phung bo lnga/ /rang dbang mi thub mi rtag 'jig pa'i phyir/ /khyab pa 'du byed sdug bsngal ces bya la/ /shin tu tsha tshe bsil bar gyur pa dang*/ /zas kyi tshor ba bde ba myong ba dag /'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal nyid du rnam par bzhag /nad la sogs pa'i rkyen las byung ba yi/ /tshor ba sdug bsngal gzir ba gang yin de/ /sdug bsngal gyi ni sdug bsngal zhes bya ste/ /mdor na khams gsum 'khor ba gar skyes kyang*/ /sdug bden rang bzhin nyid las ma 'das pas/ /thar ba 'dod phyir nges 'byung bsam pa bskyed/ /sdug bsngal gang las byung ba'i dang po'i rgyu/ /nyon mongs nyid yin de las las sogs 'byung*/ /de phyir nyon mongs 'dod chags zhe sdang dang*/ /gti mug nga rgyal phrag dog ser sna sogs/ /ji ltar nus pa'i gnyen pos spong bar rigs/ /de yang sdug bsngal gsum gyi rigs rnams kun/ /tshul bzhin shes pa sdug bsngal bden pa shes/ /nyon mongs tshogs kyi skye dang gnas tshul rig /kun 'byung 'phags pa'i bden pa shes pa nyid/ /sdug bsngal las ni grol ba'i thabs shes na/ /de tshe lam gyi bden pa shes pa ste/ /lam gyis sdug bsngal 'gog cing 'gags pa shes/ /'gog pa 'phags pa'i bden pa shes pa'o/ /nyon mongs rgyu yin sdug bsngal 'bras bu ste/ /lam bden rgyu ste 'gog bden 'bras bu'o/

/gzhan yang ma rig 'du byed rnam shes dang*/ /ming gzugs skye mched reg pa tshor ba dang*/ /sred dang len pa srid pa skye ba dang*/ /rga shi yan lag bcu gnyis 'khor lo 'dis/ /'khor ba'i sems can bar mtshams med par 'khor/ /de yang ma rig dbang gis las bsags te/ /de yi bag chags rnam shes la bsgos pa/ /sred len gnyis kyis legs par gsos btab nas/ /rnam shes phyi mar nying mtshams sbyar ba na/ /ming gzugs skye mched reg pa tshor ba dang*/ /skye dang rga shi'i rten 'brel rim par 'grub/ /ma rig 'du byed 'phen pa'i rgyu yin la/ /'bras dus rnam shes ming gzugs nas bzung ste/ /tshor ba'i bar lnga 'phangs pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /ji ltar 'phangs na rgyu dus rnam shes la/ /las kyis bag chags bsgos pa'i tshul gyis 'phen/ /sred len srid las 'grub pa'i rgyu nyid de/ /skye dang rga shi grub pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /ji ltar 'grub na bag chags bsgos pa de/ /nus mthu can du byas pa'i tshul gyis so/ /ma rig pa dang sred pa len pa gsum/ /nyon mongs yin te 'du byed srid pa las/ /rnam shes ming gzugs skye mched reg tshor dang*/ /skye ba rga shi bdun ni sdug bden no/ /nyon mongs gsum las las ni gnyis 'byung zhing*/ /de las sdug bsngal bdun 'byung bdun las slar/ /nyon mongs sogs 'byung mgal me'i 'khor lo bzhin/ /bcu gnyis rnam pas srid pa'i 'khor lo bskor/ /de dag rtsa ba ma rig pa yin te/ /bslab pa gsum dang khyad par chos kun gyi/ /rang bzhin bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis/ /ma rig spong ba'i tshul la 'bad par bya/ /gal te sems can don phyir sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang 'dod na byang chub sems mchog bskyed/ /theg pa chen por 'jug pa'i sgo gcig bu/ /byang chub sems las gzhan ni yod ma yin/ /gang gis sems 'di bskyed par ma byas na/ /de la yon tan brgya phrag gzhan yod kyang*/ /byang chub sems dpar nam yang mi 'gyur la/

/gang gis 'di bskyed yon tan gzhan med kyang*/ /rgyal ba'i sras 'gyur lhar bcas kun gyi skyabs/ /'di la sbyong tshul rnam pa mang na yang*/ /bsdu na gnyis te sems can thams cad ni/ /rang gi mar shes de yi drin dran dang*/ /drin du gzo dang yid 'ong byams pa dang*/ /snying rje chen po lhag bsam rnam dag drug /'bras bu byang chub sems te rnam bdun gyis/ /sbyong ba rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun gyis dang*/ /sems can kun gyi sdug bsngal rang gis len/ /rang gi bde dge gzhan la gtong ba yis/ /sbyong tshul byams dang snying rjes sbyong ba ste/ /mdor na sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las/ /skyob 'dod snying rje bcos ma ma yin pa/ /su zhig la yod byang chub sems mchog ni/ /skyes sam skye 'gyur rgyu yi gtso bo yin/ /sems can gzhan la cung zad mi 'tshe bar/ /zhi dul gnas pa tsam gyis byang sems min/ /yin na nyan thos rang rgyal dgra bcom kyang*/ /byang chub sems dpa' nyid du thal bar 'gyur/ / gzhan dag 'ga' la gnod pa tsam gyis kyang*/ /rgyal ba'i sras su 'jog tu mi rung min/ /gal te yin na sangs rgyas byang sems ni/ /rgyal bo'i tshul bzung log par zhugs pa gzhan/ /bcings dang rdeg sogs med par thal ba dang*/ /byang chub sems dpas mngon spyod las dag kyang*/ /gzhan gyi don du byed par mi rung 'gyur/ /gzhan yang so so skye bo'i byang sems can/ khong khro sogs kyang med par thal 'gyur phyir/ /phyi yi spyod tshul tsam gyis rgyal ba'i sras/ /yin min ji bzhin nges par mi nus so/ /de phyir sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las/ /bsgral te sangs rgyas nyid la 'god pa'i ched/ /rang nyid kun mkhyen don du gnyer byed pa'i/ /sems mchog tshig tsam min pa zhig yod na/ /byang chub sems dpa' nyid du rnam par bzhag /'di dang stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab la/ /phan yon rgya cher mdo las gsal bar bshad/

/sems de bskyed nas spyod pa phyin drug la/ /'jug par bya ste rgyal sras spyod pa'i sdom/ /pha rol phyin pa drug tu 'dus gsungs pas/ /tshul 'dir bslab par bya ba gnad du che/ /sbyin pa la ni rnam pa gsum yod de/ /chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs sbyin pa'o/ /gzhan la chos ston chos kyi sbyin pa ste/ /zas sogs ster ba zang zing sbyin pa nyid/ /'jigs pa las skyob mi 'jigs sbyin pa'o/ /tshul khrims gsum ste sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ /dge ba chos sdud sems can don byed do/ /bcas dang rang bzhin kha na ma tho ba'i/ /nyes pa spong ba sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ /phyin drug bskyed dang gnas dang spel ba'i phyir/ /'jug par byed pa dge ba chos sdud yin/ /sems can don ni tshul bzhin sgrub byed pa/ /sems can don byed tshul khrims zhes bya'o/ /bzod pa gsum ste gnod pa bzod pa dang*/ /sdug bsngal dang len chos la nges thob bzod/ /rang la gnod byed bzod pa dang po ste/ /sdug bsngal byung ba bzod pa gnyis pa yin/ /chos nyid shes shing mos pa gsum par 'dod/ /brtson 'grus gsum ste go cha'i brtson 'grus dang*/ /dge ba chos sdud sems can don byed gsum/ /mi skyo sems can don brtson dang po nyid/ /dge chos sems can don byed sngar bzhin yin/ / bsam gtan gnyis te 'jig rten 'das ma 'das/ /yang na zhi lhag zung 'brel bcas pa'o/ /shes rab rnam pa gsum ste kun rdzob dang*/ /don dam rtogs pa'i shes rab rnam gnyis steng*/ /sems can don sgrub byed pa'i shes rab po/ / bsam gtan shes rab rnam gnyis so so la/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong zhes ni rab bshad pa/ /de yi dbye ba rgyas par gzhan du shes/ /sbyin gtong snyan par smra bas dam chos ston/ /bstan pa'i don la gdul bya spyod 'jug dang*/ /rang nyid don mthun spyod pa bsdu dngos bzhi/ /phar phyin drug gis rang rgyud smin byed cing*/

/ bsdu ba bzhi yis gzhan don bsgrub bya ste/ /'khor sdud pa la'ang 'di nyid mchog tu gsung*/ /sbyin pas longs spyod 'byor ba 'thob par 'gyur/ /rang gis mdza' bshes byams shing snyan pa 'thob/ /tshul khrims kyis ni ngan 'gro las thar nas/ /bde 'gro'i lus rnyed rgyan gyi mchog kyang yin/ /bzod pas gzugs bzang dgra rnams zhi bar byed/ /dge ba sgrub byed dka' thub kun gyi mchog /brtson 'grus kyis ni 'di dang phyi ma yi/ /don chen ma lus sgrub par byed par 'gyur/ /bsam gtan gyis ni mngon par shes pa sogs/ /gong ma'i yon tan khyad par 'grub par byed/ /shes rab kyis ni nyon mongs mi shes kun/ /drung nas phyung ste kun mkhyen nyid kyang 'grub/ /gzhan yang mdo sde las ni 'di ltar gsung*/ /bag yod yon tan kun gyi gzhi yin te/ /'dod chung chog shes phyug po nyid du 'dod/ /dad pa tshul khrims thos dang gtong ba dang*/ /ngo tsha shes dang khrel yod shes rab ste/ /bdun po 'phags pa'i nor gyi mchog yin pas/ /gang la 'di yod nor dang ldan zhes bya/ /med na don gyis dbul bo nyid du gsung*/ /des mtshon rgyal sras spyod pa'i rab dbye ni/ /mdo las bshad rnams shes shing ci nus slob/ /gzhan yang zhi gnas lhag mthong gi /khyad par cung zad bstan par bya/ /zhi gnas ngo bo bsam gtan te/ /sems ni rtse gcig pa nyid yin/ /de yang spyod lam tshul mthun pas/ kha dog gser ltar mdzes pa yi/ /rgyal ba'i sku brnyan la dmigs te/ /bying rgod la sogs skyon bral ba'i/ / zhi gnas bsgrub par bya'o gsung*/ /de tshe le lo gdams ngag brjed/ /bying rgod 'du byed 'du mi byed/ /nyes pa rnam pa lnga spangs nas/ /dad dang 'dun pa rtsol ba dang*/ /shin sbyangs dran dang shes bzhin dang*/ /btang snyoms 'du byed gnyen po brgyad/ /bsten par dbus mtha' las gsungs dang*/ /'jog dang rgyun du 'jog pa dang*/

/blan te 'jog dang nye bar 'jog /dul bar byed dang zhi bar byed/ /rnam par zhi byed rtse gcig byed/ /mnyam par 'jog dang rgyud gcig byed/ /gsungs bzhin sems gnas thabs dgu dang*/ /thos pa'i stobs dang bsams pa dang*/ /dran dang shes bzhin brtson 'grus dang*/ /yongs su 'dris pa'i stobs drug gam/ /bsgrim ste 'jug dang chad cing 'jug /chad pa med par 'jug pa dang*/ /rtsol med 'jug pa'i yid byed bzhi/ /tshul bzhin bsten te zhi gnas bsgrub/ /gang tshe sems dang lus kyi yang*/ /shin sbyangs skyes pa'i mjug nyid nas/ /yid ni rtse gcig dmigs pa la/ /lhan ner brtan par gyur pa'i tshe/ /zhi gnas thob par rab tu bshad/ /lta ba sgom par byed pa'i sngon/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs byas te/ /rten 'brel gyi ni gtan tshigs sogs/ /don dam dpyod byed rigs pa la/ /brten nas lta ba btsal bar bya/ /'dir ni gcig dang du bral gyi/ /gtan tshigs mdor bsdus brjod byas na/ /'di la gnad ni rnam pa bzhi/ /dang po dgag bya nges pa'i gnad/ /rang cag rnams la nga'o snyam/ /spring sbring snying gi thad nyid du/ /'dzin pa'i blo 'dis nga gang du/ /ji 'dra ci zhig ltar bzung brtag /de ltar brtags tshe de yis ni/ /lus sems so so'i steng nyid nas/ /re re kho na ma yin par/ /lus sems 'tshogs pa 'di yi thog /ming brdas bzhag tsam ma yin par/ /btags don nga zhig yul steng nas/ /bltos med rang rkya thub pa zhig /yod par bzung bar shes par bya/ /gnyis pa khyab pa nges pa'i gnad/ /de ltar bzung bzhin grub pa'i nga*/ /lus sems 'di dang gcig pa'am/ /tha dad grub pa gang rung zhig /yin gyi gzhan du med shes bya/ /gsum pa bden pa'i gcig bral ni/ /bden 'dzin lhan skyes kyis bzung ba'i/ /nga de lus sems 'di gnyis dang*/ /gcig gam tha dad gang yin brtag /gcig go zhe na nga nyid kyang*/ /lus sems gnyis kar thal bar 'gyur/

/gal te lus dang gcig yin na/ /nga nyid gzugs su 'gyur phyir dang*/ /nga yi lus zhes brjod pa'i tshe/ /nga ni lus las tha dad du/ /brjod cing blo la'ang tha dad par/ /snang gi gcig tu snang ma yin/ /gal te gcig na lus zhig nas/ /nga nyid skye ba len pa'i tshe/ /lus kyang skye ba len dgos na/ /de ni sus kyang ma mthong phyir/ /lus dang gcig tu ma grub bo/ /sems dang yang ni gcig min te/ /nga yi sems zhes brjod pa'i tshe/ /nga sems gnyis ka tha dad du/ /snang gi gcig tu snang mi srid/ /snang na'ang nga nyid shes par 'gyur/ /shes pa yin na mig shes kyis/ /yan lag gzugs dang ldan pa yi/ /nga nyid khyod kyis a mthong tham/ /bzhi ba bden pa'i du bral ni/ /gal te ngar 'dzin gyis bzung ltar/ /nga de lus sems gnyis ka dang*/ /ma 'brel tha dad grub ce na/ /'o na lus sems so sor yang*/ /bsal ba'i 'og tu de 'dra'i nga*/ khyod kyis bstan par nus sam ci/ /lus sems gnyis las don gzhan du/ /bltos med yan gar nga med pas/ /de ltar tha dad grub ma yin/ /gzhan yang skyes bu rang lus kyi/ /sha rus pags pa khrag chu ser/ /drod dang dbugs dang bu ga dang*/ /rnam par shes sogs ma yin la/ /de las gzhan la'ang ma yin te/ /skyes bu sa min chu ma yin/ /me min rlung min nam mkha' min/ /rnam shes ma yin kun min na/ /de las gzhan na skyes bu gang*/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa nyid phyir ro/ /gzhan yang ngar 'dzin lhan skyes kyis/ /yan lag rnam pa lnga yi steng*/ /lus zhes btags pa tsam min par/ /yul steng nas ni tshugs se ba/ / grub grub zhig tu bzung ba ni/ /brtags la dgag bya ngos zin bya/ /de nas de ltar bzung ba'i lus/ /lings po gzugs bzhi'i steng yod na/ /lus 'di'i yan lag rnam lnga dang*/ /gcig gam tha dad gang zhig yin/ /thag gcod khyab pa nges pa'i gnad/ /gcig tu grub na lus tshang ma/ /yan lag lnga ru 'gyur ba'i phyir/

/mgo la'ang rkang lag yod par 'gyur/ /de phyir yan lag re re la/ / lus ni tshang ba re re dang*/ /yang na yan lag rnam lnga yi/ /gzhi 'thun lus kyang yod par 'gyur/ /de phyir gcig tu ma grub bsam/ /gal te bltos med tha dad du/ /grub na'ang yan lag lnga bo las/ /ma gtogs lus ni tshang ba zhigakhyod kyis gang du rnyed par nus/ /de phyir tha dad ma grub bsam/ /de bzhin ri dang khang khyim dang*/ /bum pa sogs kyang rang rang gi /stod smad g.yas g.yon la sogs kyi/ /rdul dang gcig gam tha dad par/ /brtags la sngar bzhin 'gog par byed/ /de bzhin de ring shes pa yang*/ /snga dro phyi dro'i shes pa dang*/ / lo ni zla ba bcu gnyis dang*/ /bltos med gcig dang tha dad du/ /grub pa brtags la gzhag par bya/ /mdor na shing rta lta bu ni/ /rang gi gdags gzhi tshogs pa la/ /brten nas ming brdas bzhag tsam zhig /ma gtogs rang gi ngos nas ni/ /grub pa med par thag bcad de/ /chos rnams kun kyang rang rang gi /cha shas tshogs pa la brten nas/ /bzhag pa'i tshul ni shes par bya/ /de tshe don dam dpyod byed kyi/ /rigs pas dpyad ngor mi rnyed kyang*/ /rmi lam sgyu ma ji bzhin du/ /las dang 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag kun/ /tha snyad du ni 'thad pa'i tshul/ /rgyas par gzhan du shes par bya/ /rnam mang gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i 'jing*/ /rnam dpyod ri dbang bsgril ba las/ /rnam dag legs bshad bdud rtsi yis/ /rnam kun gang ba'i bum bzang bskrun/ /'dir 'bad las byung rab dkar dge /ji snyed bdag gis thob de yang*/ /mtha' dag 'gro 'di kun mkhyen gyi/ /go 'phang mchog de thob phyir bsngo/ /ces pa 'di ni gnas brtan ngag dbang rgyal mtshan dang*/ grags pa dpal 'byor gnyis kyis 'di lta bu zhig gyis zhes bskul ba ltar/ shākya'i dge slong rab 'byams smra ba grags pa bshad sgrub kyis gzhan la'ang phan srid snyam ste co ne ting 'dzin dar rgyas gling du bgyis pa'o/

/maṅga laṃ// // na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ 'dir bsags sbyang gi gnad bsdus pa yan lag bdun pa'i nyams len rgyun khyer du byed pa'i tshul la gnyis/ sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ dkon mchaug gi rten gyi drung du mchod pa bshams pa sogs byas te/ skyabs 'gro sogs sngon du btang nas/ mchog gsum rgyal ba sras bcas byin rlabs dang*/ /tshogs gnyis mnga' thang chos dbyings bden stobs kyis/ /zhing 'di bde ba can ltar snod bcud kyi/ /'byor ldan mchod tshogs rgya mtshos gang gyur cig /ces sam bden pa'i byin brlab bya/ rab 'byams zhing nas rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*/ /yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang tshogs/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bstan srung rgya mtshor bcas/ /spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs dgongs shing bzhugs su gsol/ /zhes pas spyan drangs te mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i mos pa shugs can bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bdun gyi dang po phyag 'tshal ba ni/ /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i ston pa zas gtsang sras/ /byams brtse'i bdag nyid mi pham chos kyi rje/ /rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med sku mched sogs/ /rgya chen spyod pa'i brgyud la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rgyal ba'i mkhyen rab dbang phyug 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /rten 'brel don gzigs 'phags mchog klu sgrub zhabs/ /de sras thu bo zla ba grags pa sogs/ /zab mo lta ba'i brgyud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bstan pa'i sgron me jo bo yab sras dang*/ /rgyal ba kun dngos rje btsun btsong kha ba/ /rgyal tshab 'dul 'dzin mkhas grub chen po sogs/ /bshes gnyen dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i rje/ /ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /mchog sprul dam pa blo bzang ye shes sogs/ /dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'chang chen in+d+ra bho dhi dang/ /lū hi dā ri ka dang dril bu ba/ /sa ra ha dang sha ba ri la sogs/

/grub chen bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang las mdo rgyud dbang lung man ngag gi /cha shas phra mo yan chad tsam zhig kyang*/ /bka' drin mnos pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa sogs/ /drin can bla ma rnams la la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshan legs yongs bsgrags dpal sogs bde gshegs brgyad/ /shāka thub la sogs rgyal ba sum cu lnga/ /'khor ba 'jig sogs sangs rgyas stong phrag bcas/ /dus gsum rgyal ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas nyi zla mar me gsal nyi khri/ /mar me mdzad dpal zhes grags sum khri dang*/ /'od mi 'gyur ba 'bum phrag brgya la sogs/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gsal rgyal 'bum phrag rnam pa bcu/ /sprul sku shākya thub pa sa ya gcig /mi 'khrugs sman bla tshe dpag med la sogs/ /nga lta'i sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun tu dpal ba sum khri dang*/ /'od mi 'gyur ba bzhi khri stong phrag brgyad/ /'od zer rnam par bkod pa 'bum brgyad sogs/ /ma byon sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mdo sde lung bstan tshigs bcad dbyangs kyis bsnyad/ /ched brjod gleng gzhi rtogs dang 'das pa brjod/ /skyes rabs shin rgyas rmad byung gtan phab sde'i/ /yan lag bcu gnyis gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dul ba mngon pa mdo sde rnam gsum dang*/ /bya spyod yo ga rnal 'byor bla na med/ /gang gi dgongs 'grel legs par bshad pa sogs/ /lung gi dam chos rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bslab gsum nges 'byung byang sems yang dag lta/ /phyin drug sa bcu lam lnga rim gnyis sogs/ /grol byed lam dang grol ba'i 'gog pa ste/ /rtogs pa'i dam chos rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byams pa 'jam dbyangs phyag rdor spyan ras gzigs/ /sa snying sgrib sel nam snying kun tu bzang*/ /blo gros mi bzang nam mkha' mdzod la sogs/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bzang skyong dbang bo zhi sogs rgyal ba'i

sras/ /gdung sel snang ba brtsegs sogs rang sangs rgyas/ /'od srung rab 'byor la sogs nyan thos te/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shā ri'i bu sogs nyan thos chen po brgyad/ /legs mthong la sogs bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun/ /yan lag 'byung sogs gnas brtan bcu drug bcas/ /'phags pa nyan thos rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa 'khor lo sdom/ /dgyes rdor dus kyi 'khor lo gshin rje gshed/ /rdor dbyings kun rig la sogs rgyud sde bzhi'i/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdugs dkar sgrol ma rnam rgyal dbyangs can ma/ /seng gdong ri khrod ma dang 'od zer can/ /ral gcig phag mo mkha' 'gro sde lnga sogs/ /zhi khro lha mo'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs dang mtshams kyi gdon bgegs 'byung ba'i tshogs/ /tshar gcod drag po'i skur bzhengs 'jigs tshul can/ /hūṃ mdzad 'khor bsgyur gshin rje gshed la sogs/ /rab brjid khro bo'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan mgon po phyag drug zhal bzhi pa/ /phyag bzhi gur mgon bram gzugs chos kyi rgyal/ / dmag zor rgyal mo rnam sras beg tse sogs/ /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsdu na/ dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag byar 'os pa sogs kyang bya'o/ /gnyis pa mchod pa ni/ ma lus phyogs bcu'i zhing na gang mchis pa'i/ /yid 'ong mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos/ /snang gsal dri chab zhal zas rol mo dang*/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i tshogs rnams 'bul/ /'khor lo nor bu btsun mo blon po dang*/ /glang chen rta mchog dmag dpon rin po che/ /gdugs dang gser nya bum pa pad+ma dung*/ /dpal be'u rgyal mtshan 'khor lo rnams kyang 'bul/

/khrus rdzing gos dang rin chen gzhal med khang*/ /dbu rgyan cod pan bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i sgra/ /gling bzhi stong gsum nyi zla ri rab sogs/ /bdag lus longs spyod dge tshogs bcas te 'bul/ / ji ltar rgyal sras kun bzang la sogs pas/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams la mchod mdzad pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis mchod pa'i sprin tshogs kyis/ /skyabs mgon dam pa 'khor bcas mchod par bgyi/ gsum pa bshags pa ni/ thog med dus nas nyon mongs dbang gyur te/ /mi dge bcu dang mtshams med lnga la sogs/ /gang yang lus ngag yid kyis sdig pa'i las/ /ji snyed bgyis pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /dkon mchog gsum dang mkhan slob pha ma dang*/ /dam chos smra ba rnams la ma zhus shing*/ /las dang 'bras bu'i blang dor phra rags la/ /rmongs pas log lta byas rnams mthol lo bshags/ /so thar byang sems gsang sngags sdom pa yi/ /bslab bya rnams dang 'gal bar rab tu spyad/ /'phags pa'i tshogs rnams mnyes par mi 'gyur ba'i/ /bcas rang sdig ltung kun kyang so sor bshags/ /mdor na mtho ris thar pa'i gegs byed cing*/ /ngan song 'khor ba'i rgyur gyur nyes pa'i tshogs/ /gang yin de kun mi 'chab 'gyod sems kyis/ /bshags shing slan chad mi bgyid yang dag sdom/ /yan lag lhag ma rnams ni/ rang bzhin skye 'phags yongs kyis dus gsum du/ /bsags pa'i rnam dkar phung bo ji snyed dang*/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i mdzad pa mtha' dag la/ /bsam pa thag pas rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /ma lus phyogs bcu'i zhing na rab bzhugs pa'i/ /rgyal ba sras bcas nyan rang 'phags tshogs la/ /'gro rnams phan bde'i dpal la 'god pa'i ched/ /zab dang rgya che'i chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /gang dag mya ngan 'da' tshul ston bzhed pa/ /de kun ji srid 'khor ba'i phyi mtha'i rgyun/ /ma stong de srid du yang 'jig rten 'dir/ /mya ngan mi 'da' rtag par legs bzhugs gsol/ /'di ltar bgyis pa las byung rnam dkar dge

/dus gsum legs tshogs gcig tu bsdoms byas gang*/ /mtha' yas sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob phyir bsngo/ /mchog gsum skyabs mgon dam pa 'khor bcas la/ /bdag ni gdung shugs drag pos gus gsol bas/ /nges 'byung byang sems yang dag lta ba sogs/ /myur du rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /de yi mthu las tshe rabs thams cad du/ /mi khom las grol dal pa'i rten thob cing*/ /dus kun dge ba'i bshes dang 'phrad gyur nas/ /mdo sngags dam chos ma lus 'dzin par shog /ces bya'o/ /yang na yan lag dang po gsum la/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus sogs dang*/ bla ma sangs rgyas sogs/ sku 'gyur ba med sogs dang*/ zab mo lta ba'i sogs dang*/ rab 'byams gsung rab sogs dang sangs rgyas rnam gzigs sogs dang*/ mtshan legs rin chen sogs dang*/ mthun pa'i smon lam sogs dang*/ phyogs bcu'i 'gro la sogs dang*/ mar me mdzad sogs sogs dang*/ smra bsam brjod med sogs dang*/ kun 'byung mun pa'i sogs dang*/ 'jam dbyangs phyag na sogs dang*/ spangs dang ye shes sogs dang*/ ston pa sangs rgyas sogs dang*/ sgrub pa po la sogs dang*/ dpal ldan dus 'khor rje btsun sgrol ma rnam rgyal sogs dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sogs ci rigs kyis phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ me tog dam pa nas mchod par bgyi'i bar dang*/ bdag gzhan lus ngag sogs kyis mchod pa 'bul ba dang*/ lus kyi las ni sogs dang*/ thog ma med nas sogs kyis bshags pa byas kyang rung la/ yan lag lhag ma ni sngar ltar ro/ bdun po shin tu bsdu na/ ji snyed su dag sogs kyis bya'o/ /de yang phyag 'tshal dang mchod pa bskul ba gsol ba rjes su yi rang ba rnams ni mthun rkyen tshogs gsog pa'i yan lag dang*/ bshags pa'i 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong ba yin la/ bsngo ba ni dge ba rnams las chung ngu chen po dang nyung ngu mang bor spel zhing 'bras bu nam yang mi zad pa'i thabs so/

/der ma zad yon tan dang yon tan can nam dge ba byed pa gzhan la dga' zhing de dag gi dge ba la rjes su yi rang bar byas na phan yon chen po thob cing rang gis byas pa'i dge ba la dga' ba bsgoms na dge ba gong 'phel du 'gro bar bshad pas/ de'i shugs kyis na gzhan dang de'i dge ba byed pa la phrag dog gis mi dga' ba'am/ rang gis byas pa'i dge ba la phyis 'gyod par gyur na ni rang gi bsod nams dang dge ba 'grib par 'gyur ba bstan to/ /yan lag de dag bsdu na tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong gnyis su 'du ste/ gnyis ka 'gal ba yang min no/ /de ltar yan lag bdun pa la ring du 'bad na ni gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don chen po rnams 'grub par 'gyur zhing*/ khyad par du'ang deng dus bsdus lam gyi yon tan phran tshegs rgyud la skye ba ni/ rten gyi drung du tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong byed pa la rag las pa yin te/ lam rim chen mo las/ lam rgyud la skye ba'i mthun rkyen tshogs bsag pa dang 'gal rkyen sgrib pa sbyong ba'i lhan cig byed rkyen med na nyer len gyi rgyu dmigs rnam skyong ba tsam la 'bad kyang lam shin tu skye dka' bas bsag sbyang gi gnad bsdus pa'i yan lag bdun pas rgyud sbyang dgos so/ /zhes dang*/ de ltar zhing dam pa la dge rtsa bskrun pa'i mthu las lam gyi rim pa rnams la blo'i mthu je rgyas su 'gro bas/ mnyan na tshig mi zin/ bsams na don mi go / bsgoms na rgyud la mi skye ba'i blo'i mthu shin tu chung ba'i dus su zhing gi mthu la brten pa man ngag yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /smras pa/ gsung rab dgongs 'grel kun gyi brjod bya'i don/ /mchog dman bar ma'i khyad par gyis phye ste/ lag tu len pa'i rim pa ches mang yang*/ /gnad kun gcig bsgril yan lag bdun pa'o/ /tshul 'di sngon byon bshes gnyen du mas kyang*/ /dus kun nyams len gtso bor mdzad gyur na/
